title: Rav Shlomo Steinhaus Passes Away
body: Gateshead yeshiva community mourns Rav Shlomo Steinhaus zt”l, 77, who served decades as R”M at Yeshivas Tiferes Yaakov, found preparing his daily shiur when he passed away.

title: Breslover Mashpia Passes Away
body: Rav Binyamin Zev Knopelmacher zt”l, a prominent Breslover mashpia, has passed away at 75 after years of illness. Thousands sought his brocha and counsel for decades.
